title: A Provision for the Summit
author: Coral Ashgrove
blurb: Juniper Villalobos, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
